results.title: Calculating your personal transfer balance cap
results.description:
# Calculating your personal transfer balance cap
## Your personal transfer balance cap
The general transfer balance cap is increased (indexed) in line with the consumer price index in $100,000 increments.

## Indexation of your personal transfer balance cap
### Example: highest ever balance below $1.6 million before indexation with credits
The general transfer balance cap was indexed by $100,000 to $1.7 million from 1 July 2021.

The general transfer balance cap was indexed by $200,000 to $1.9 million from 1 July 2023.

The general transfer balance cap was indexed by $100,000 to $2 million from 1 July 2025.

### Example: Starting another retirement phase income stream
Nada's personal transfer balance cap will be indexed by 50% of $100,000 (the increment) on 1 July 2026, increasing it to $2.025 million, when the general transfer balance is indexed to $2.1 million.

# Upcoming personal transfer balance cap changes
The general transfer balance cap (TBC) will be indexed on 1 July 2026, increasing by $100,000 from $2 million to $2.1 million.
